properties.displayName: [FedRAMP High] Azure AD B2C: Audit Token Lifetime Configuration
properties.description: Audits that Azure AD B2C token lifetime settings conform to organizational policy. Access tokens should not exceed 1 hour and refresh tokens should not exceed 24 hours for session management compliance. FedRAMP High requires session controls per SC-23 and credential management per IA-5.

metadata.description: Audit: Report non-compliance. Disabled: Do not evaluate. Note: B2C token lifetime is configured via custom policies or user flows, not Azure resource policy. This audit policy checks for the existence of a B2C directory resource.
